function.name: calculate_derivative
function.description: Calculate the derivative of a polynomial function. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

So step1: call calculate_derivative(function="3x^3 - 2x^2 + 5x - 7") -> returns derivative function string. Then call calculate_derivative(function=derivative_function_string, x_value=4) -> returns numeric derivative at x=4.

Then step2: differentiate the derivative function again: call calculate_derivative(function=derivative_function_string) -> returns second derivative function string. Then evaluate at x=2: call calculate_derivative(function=second_derivative_function_string, x_value=2) -> numeric.
